main.sync_disabled_same: The worlds are identical — nothing to sync
main.sync_disabled_locked: The world is open in the game. Close it in Minecraft on both computers
main.sync_disabled_not_linked: First choose which instance on the other computer to link this one to
main.hint: Press «Sync» next to the world you want to move between computers
main.peer_error: Could not get the worlds of the other computer. {error}
main.sync_request_busy: The other computer asks to take the world «{world}», but another sync is in progress.
instances.recent_hint: The worlds you played most recently, from all instances
instances.linked: Linked to instance «{name}» on {peer}: worlds from here sync with it
instances.choose: Which instance on {peer} should «{name}» be linked to? You only need to choose once.
instances.wait_peer: You can choose the instance on {peer} when {peer} is online
sync.title: Sync «{world}»
sync.nothing_to_do: The worlds are already identical, nothing to sync.
sync.warning_receiver_newer: The world on «{receiver}» was changed later than on «{source}». Are you sure you played on «{source}»?
sync.warning_downgrade: The world on «{receiver}» was saved by a newer game version than on «{source}». The game may not open it after syncing.
sync.warning_mass_delete: More than {percent}% of the world files will be deleted on «{receiver}».
sync.blocker_locked: The world is open in the game. Close it in Minecraft on both computers.
sync.blocker_space: Not enough space on «{receiver}»: {required} needed, {free} free.
sync.blocker_source_missing: «{source}» doesn't have this world. Syncing would delete it on «{receiver}» too.
sync.incoming: {peer} is sending the world «{world}» to this computer.
sync.backup_saved:
The previous version of the world was saved as a backup:
{path}
sync.no_backup_needed: This world wasn't here before, so no backup was needed.
sync.push_requested: Request sent. {peer} is taking the world «{world}» — the progress is shown on {peer}.
note.title: World description
note.heading: Description of «{world}»
note.hint: The description is only shown in MineSync — on both computers. The world itself doesn't change. Leave the field empty to remove the description.
history.title: Sync history
toast.title: Sync complete!
toast.text: «{world}» is now the same as on {source}
pairing.title: Pairing
pairing.show_code_group: Show a code on this computer
pairing.show_code_hint: Press the button and enter the code on the other computer.
pairing.code_left: The code is valid for {time} more.
pairing.code_expired: The code has expired. Press «Show code» again.
pairing.enter_code_group: Enter a code from the other computer
pairing.enter_code_hint: Choose the computer and enter the 6 digits it shows.
pairing.no_devices: No computers found on the network
pairing.device_gone: The computer disappeared from the network. Check that MineSync is running on it.
backups.title: Backups
backups.hint:
Before each sync the previous version of the world is saved here:
{path}
backups.confirm_restore:
Restore the world «{world}» from this backup?
The current version will be backed up too.
backups.confirm_delete: Delete this backup? This can't be undone.
settings.title: Settings
settings.hint:
Instances are added with the «+» button above the world list.
If no backups folder is set, backups are kept in the app's data folder.
settings.error_name: Enter a name for this computer.
settings.error_backups_inside_saves: The backups folder can't be inside the saves folder: the game would treat backups as worlds.
error.cancelled: Sync cancelled. The world wasn't changed.
error.world_locked: The world is open in the game. Close it in Minecraft on both computers.
error.no_space: Not enough disk space: {required} needed, {free} free.
error.unexpected: Unexpected error. Details were written to the log.
error.already_running: MineSync is already running on this computer. Look for its window in the taskbar or the Dock.
instances.confirm_remove:
Remove the instance «{name}» from MineSync?
Its worlds and files are not deleted — you can add it again with «+».
instances.error_no_saves:
No worlds folder (saves) was found in «{folder}».

Choose the instance folder — the one that contains a saves folder. For example, in Prism Launcher it's …/PrismLauncher/instances/<instance>, for the regular launcher it's the .minecraft folder.
instances.error_already_added: This instance is already in the list as «{name}».
instances.empty: No instances yet. Press «+» and choose an instance folder — the app will find the worlds folder inside.
settings.full_backup: Full world backup on every sync
settings.full_backup_hint: Off (fast): only changed files are transferred and their old versions go to the backup — the disk is barely used. On: the whole world is saved before syncing — safer, but slower for big worlds and heavy on the disk.
backups.confirm_restore_delta:
Undo the sync of the world «{world}»?
The old versions of the files it replaced or deleted will come back. If you have played in this world since, only those files will be restored — it's best to undo right away.
The current versions will be backed up too.
error.net_connect: Could not connect to the other computer. Is it on and is MineSync running on it?
error.net_certificate: The other computer's certificate doesn't match the one saved during pairing. If MineSync was reinstalled there, forget the computer and pair again.
error.net_timeout: The other computer is not responding.
error.net_lost: The connection to the other computer was lost. The world wasn't changed — try again.
error.net_unauthorized: The other computer rejected the request: the computers aren't paired. Pair them again.
error.net_not_found: This world or instance wasn't found on the other computer.
error.net_status: The other computer replied with error {status}. Details were written to the log.
error.net_corrupted: A file arrived damaged. The world wasn't changed — try again.
error.source_changed: The world on the other computer changed during the transfer (maybe it was opened in the game). The world here wasn't changed — try again.
error.sync_size_mismatch: The file {path} didn't arrive completely. The world wasn't changed — try again.
error.pair_no_code: The other computer has no active code. Press «Show code» there.
error.pair_bad_message: Pairing failed: damaged data was received. Try again.
error.pair_busy: Too many pairing attempts. Try again.
error.pair_expired: The code has expired. Show a new code and enter it.
error.pair_not_confirmed: The other computer didn't confirm the code — someone may be interfering on the network. Pairing was cancelled.
sync.suggest_checking: Checking where the world changed since the last sync…
sync.suggest_here: Looks like you played here last: since the last sync ({time}) the world changed only on this computer.
sync.suggest_there: Looks like you played on «{peer}» last: since the last sync ({time}) the world changed only there.
sync.suggest_newer_here: Looks like you played here last: the world files on this computer are newer.
sync.suggest_newer_there: Looks like you played on «{peer}» last: the world files there are newer.
sync.suggest_only_here: This world exists only on this computer.
sync.suggest_conflict: Careful: since the last sync ({time}) the world changed on both computers. Choose whose version to keep — the changes on the other computer will be lost (the old file versions stay in a backup).
sync.warning_both_changed: Since the last sync the world changed on both «{source}» and «{receiver}». The changes on «{receiver}» will be lost (the old file versions will be kept in a backup).
sync.warning_receiver_changed: Since the last sync the world changed only on «{receiver}», not on «{source}». Are you sure you played on «{source}» last?
sync.compressed: Thanks to compression only {sent} went over the network ({percent}% less).
